program_rules_snapshot: Historical contest ran from 2025-08-06 through 2025-09-20. In-scope impacts included consensus flaws, peer-to-peer network flaws, and cryptographic flaws. Only code paths enabled by mainnet or mainnet-small configuration qualify. Network-level DoS and protocol smart contracts were out of scope. Testing must remain local and must not affect public networks or services.
deployment_evidence: The historical contest required NETWORK_PRESET=mainnet-small ./ci/run-local-deployment.sh. Treat a path as production-reachable only when it is enabled by mainnet-small or mainnet configuration.
known_issues_snapshot: The July 2025 Hacken protocol audit at commit 0af8c04569b626dd5c0cace903998b9ec06ab5a6 is the historical known-issue baseline. Do not treat its sixteen reported root causes as new findings.
authorized_test_constraints: Static analysis and isolated local tests only. Do not send traffic or transactions to public Somnia infrastructure. Do not perform availability testing against any external service.
